_note: Independent 2026 US yield forecasts, maintained BY HAND in the GitHub editor. Two rules, and the builder enforces both: every entry needs a public source you can click and the date it was said, and nothing already published is ever edited afterwards. A forecaster being wrong is the point of this panel, not a defect in it. When USDA prints the January final, fill `final` under each crop and the builder scores everyone at once.
_adding_one: Copy a block under `forecasts`. `as_of` is the date the number was PUBLISHED, not the date you added it. `source` must resolve to the page carrying the number. Leave a crop null if that forecaster did not publish one; a missing number renders as an em dash and a reason, never as a gap in the table.
_not_in_here: AGSIST's own nowcast is deliberately absent. The builder reads it from data/yield-nowcast.json so our number on this panel can never drift from our number on the rest of the page.
